subject.title: feat(plugins): upgrade llm_input/llm_output hooks from fire-and-forget to modifying

question: Should modifying LLM interception use new or versioned hooks, or should maintainers intentionally replace the shipped observer-only `llm_input` and `llm_output` contract?
rationale: The proposal permanently changes a shipped public plugin API's timing, authority, failure behavior, and cross-runner semantics; implementation review cannot safely choose that contract direction.

options.title: Add new modifying hooks
options.body: Preserve existing observer semantics and add separately named modifying hooks with complete runner parity and documentation.

options.title: Replace shipped semantics
options.body: Accept the compatibility break and require migration guidance, latency bounds, all-runner parity, and fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer interception
options.body: Pause or close the proposal until maintainers sponsor a narrower contract with an acceptable trust boundary.

recommendation.title: Add new modifying hooks
recommendation.body: Preserve existing observer semantics and add separately named modifying hooks with complete runner parity and documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shipped observer contract and are the strongest concrete feature-history owner for deciding whether it may change.
